product_overview: AMIK CHAT is a web-based real-time messaging platform with bilingual (English/Urdu) support, multimedia sharing, WebRTC calling, contact management (including QR), and AI translation integration. The app is built with Next.js and integrates Firebase services and OneSignal for notifications.
core_goals: Provide fast, real-time one-to-one messaging with rich media support (images, files, voice, location, contact).
Enable peer-to-peer voice and video calling via WebRTC with low-latency signaling.
Support bilingual communication (automatic English/Urdu translation) and AI-powered contact suggestions.
Offer a contact request system with QR scanning and mutual contact synchronization.
Deliver a responsive PWA-like web experience with push notifications (OneSignal) and profile management.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Email/password sign up and login using InsForge/Firebase auth with session persistence and redirect to the main app on success.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Click Signup -> See account created -> Redirect to /
Navigate to /login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Click Login -> See invalid credentials error -> Remain on /login

features.name: Chat Messaging
features.description: Real-time one-to-one messaging at /chats/[id] with text, emoji, voice notes, file/image upload, location and contact sharing, message status and read receipts.
user_flows: Navigate to /chats/[id] -> Messages load from server -> Type text message -> Click Send button -> See message appear in chat -> See delivery/read status update
Navigate to /chats/[id] -> Type text message -> Click Send button -> Network error occurs -> See message send error -> Click Retry -> See message appear in chat

features.name: File & Media Sharing
features.description: Attach and send images and files from the chat input with preview, base64 immediate display, and upload progress indicators.
user_flows: Navigate to /chats/[id] -> Click attachment button -> Select file or image -> See file preview card -> Click Send -> See file message appear with preview
Navigate to /chats/[id] -> Click attachment button -> Select large file -> See file size warning or upload failure -> Cancel or compress file and retry

features.name: Voice Recording
features.description: Record and send voice messages from the chat input with microphone access, duration display and playback in chat.
user_flows: Navigate to /chats/[id] -> Click Voice recording button -> Grant microphone permission -> Record voice note -> Click Stop -> Click Send -> See voice message appear with playback controls
Navigate to /chats/[id] -> Click Voice recording button -> Deny microphone permission -> See permission required error -> Prompt to enable microphone in browser settings

features.name: Calling (Voice & Video)
features.description: Initiate peer-to-peer WebRTC voice or video calls from the chat interface with signaling via Firestore and call controls.
user_flows: Navigate to /chats/[id] -> Click Voice call button -> Request microphone permission -> Call document created in backend -> Recipient receives incoming call notification -> Recipient clicks Accept -> WebRTC signaling completes -> See connected call interface
Navigate to /chats/[id] -> Click Video call button -> Request camera permission -> User denies camera permission -> See permission required error -> Call not started

features.name: Profile Management
features.description: View and edit user profile at /me and /me/profile including avatar upload, name edit, and copy user ID functionality.
user_flows: Navigate to /me -> Click Edit profile -> Navigate to /me/profile -> Upload new avatar -> Change name field -> Click Save -> See updated profile details
Navigate to /me -> Click Edit profile -> Navigate to /me/profile -> Upload unsupported avatar file type -> See file type validation error -> Upload supported image and retry

features.name: Contact Management
features.description: Search, add, and manage contacts with a request-based workflow and a contacts list at /contacts and adding at /contacts/add.
user_flows: Navigate to /contacts/add -> Enter search query -> See matching users -> Click Add contact -> See contact request sent -> Navigate to /contacts -> See request in Requests tab
Navigate to /contacts/add -> Enter search query -> See no users found -> See suggestion to scan QR code or try different query

features.name: QR Scanner (Add Contacts / Payments)
features.description: Scan QR codes at /scan with camera access to add contacts or interact with mini-programs.
user_flows: Navigate to /scan -> Grant camera permission -> Point camera at QR code -> QR content recognized -> See contact preview -> Click Add contact -> See request sent
Navigate to /scan -> Deny camera permission -> See camera permission required message -> Offer fallback to manual search at /contacts/add

features.name: Push Notifications
features.description: Receive and interact with web push notifications via OneSignal; notifications open the relevant chat when clicked.
user_flows: While authenticated in browser -> Receive push notification -> Click notification -> Browser opens /chats/[id] -> See message highlighted in chat
Receive push notification while logged out -> Click notification -> Browser opens /login -> See prompt to sign in before accessing chat

features.name: Translation
features.description: On-demand AI translation of messages (English <-> Urdu) from the message actions menu with fallback handling.
user_flows: Navigate to /chats/[id] -> Long-press or open message menu -> Click Translate -> Translation request sent to /api/translate -> See translated text displayed beneath original message
Navigate to /chats/[id] -> Long-press or open message menu -> Click Translate -> Translation API error occurs -> See 'translation unavailable' message and option to retry

features.name: Money / Wallet (Placeholder)
features.description: Wallet and payments UI at /money; currently a partially implemented placeholder with no real transaction capability.
user_flows: Navigate to /money -> See wallet overview and placeholder controls -> Attempt to initiate a transaction -> See 'feature not implemented' or disabled action message
Navigate to /money -> Click Send payment -> See validation or backend error indicating transactions are not yet supported -> Remain on /money
